notes: v1.14.538 — SITE AUTHORITY IS NO LONGER GUESSED. Ship B of two, completing the fix .537 opened. PHANTOM_SITE.migrate() no longer seeds siteLead from the operator, so confirming a device never again silently makes whoever set it up the site's authority. ⭐ The seed was not a bad migration — its precondition evaporated. It was written for devices confirmed under the OLD single-identity model, and deferred everything else to Site Setup 'where a human states both'; v1.14.474 removed Site Lead from Site Setup, so that deferral pointed at a door that no longer asked, and a line meant for pre-split devices became the only writer of site authority in the app — firing one boot after every new setup, because the gate stamps confirmedAt. A migration is only ever as good as the destination it defers to. v1.14.537 rebuilt that destination; with somewhere to state the value, inferring it is a guess, and .418 already ruled on guesses here. ⚠ EXISTING DEVICES KEEP WHAT THEY WERE ALREADY GIVEN — nothing erases a stored siteLead (Contract 11), and a seeded value is indistinguishable from a typed one since no provenance marker exists; inventing one retroactively would be a fresh guess about the past. Correcting such a device is a one-time human edit in SITE/SYSTEM. The original reasoning is kept verbatim above the function as the record of why it was right and what changed underneath it. A new test pins the behaviour: confirming a device leaves siteLead empty.
